records.issue_text: In admin-group.js.es6 addMembers, the user-selector input is never cleared after adding, so clicking "Add" twice re-adds the same users
records.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"))` but never clears the bound `usernames` property afterward; there’s even a `// TODO: should clear the input` comment. Since the template binds the user-selector to `usernames` (`{{user-selector usernames=usernames ...}}`), clicking "Add" again will submit the same usernames again.

records.issue_text: In group.hbs, buttons inside <form class="form-horizontal"> lack type="button", so pressing Enter in the name field natively submits the form (full page reload) instead of running the Ember save action
records.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs the template was changed to wrap controls in `<form class="form-horizontal">` and includes multiple `<button {{action ...}}>...</button>` elements (save, destroy, addMembers) without an explicit `type`.
